handoffs.message: Expanded the closed-loop coordination spec across coordination-loop-spec.md, .coordination/README.md, and delivery-coordination-bus.md. Added canonical frontend-feedback/backend-delivery payloads, lovable-ui-task extension fields, and explicit mirror/replay/failure rules. Ready for review.

Review approved: coordination-loop-spec covers frontend-feedback/backend-delivery/lovable-ui-task schemas, replay contract, mirror rules, and failure ownership. Non-blocking follow-ups noted for changed_files format and payload-type table alignment.
